7199b5df65c1b688e28c.headline: URamaphosa uyala ukuthi amafu besezingeni eliphansi ngenxa kaMlambo-Ngcuka
7199b5df65c1b688e28c.dek: Owayengusekela mongameli wesifazane wokuqala eNingizimu Afrika uzothola umngcwabo wombuso wesigaba sesi-2, kanti inkonzo yesikhumbuzo ihlelwe ngoLwesibili eGoli.
7199b5df65c1b688e28c.why: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazobona amafu ehla eziteshini kuzwelonke kuze kube mhla ziyi-28 kuNovemba, kanti umngcwabo wombuso uhlelwe ngalolo suku eEastern Cape.
paragraphs: UPhumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, owayengusekela mongameli wesifazane wokuqala eNingizimu Afrika futhi owayengunobhala-jikelele wesibili e-United Nations, ukhothame ngoLwesihlanu, mhla ziyi-20 kuNovemba, eneminyaka engu-71. UMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uqinisekise ukuthi uzothola umngcwabo wombuso wesigaba sesi-2.

I-Presidency ithe umngcwabo uzofaka izinto zendabuko zeButho Lezokuvikela LaseNingizimu Afrika futhi uzoba ngoMgqibelo, mhla ziyi-28 kuNovemba, eMiddledrift eEastern Cape. URamaphosa uyale ukuthi iflegi likazwelonke linyuselwe phansi eziteshini kusukela ekuseni ngeSonto, mhla ziyi-22 kuNovemba, kuze kube kusihlwa mhla ziyi-28 kuNovemba.

Inkonzo yesikhumbuzo sombuso ihlelwe ngo-14:00 ngoLwesibili, mhla ziyi-24 kuNovemba, eSontweni LamaKhatholika laseOur Lady of Lourdes eRivonia, eGoli. UMlambo-Ngcuka ubuye waba ngumphathiswa wezaminerali namandla kanye nenkansela yaseNyuvesi yaseGoli.

15314b574f67acf70525.headline: Abathengi bezindlu bokuqala baqophe u-48.5% wezicelo
15314b574f67acf70525.dek: Imininingwane ye-ooba ikhomba ukuthi abathengi bokuqala bakhokha idiphozithi ka-8.5%, kanti izicelo ezivunyiwe zifinyelele ku-83.9% kulo nyaka.
15314b574f67acf70525.why: Abathengi bokuqala bafaka idiphozithi engu-8.5% ngesilinganiso, uma iqhathaniswa no-12.8% kubo bonke abathengi bezindlu enyangeni ka-October.
paragraphs: Abathengi bezindlu bokuqala benze u-48.5% wezicelo zemalimboleko yezindlu eNingizimu Afrika ngo-October, ngokusho kwemininingwane ye-ooba Home Loans esetshenziswe yiPam Golding Properties. Isabelo sabo besingu-46.9% ngesilinganiso kulo nyaka kuze kube manje.

Laba bathengi bakhokhe idiphozithi engu-8.5% ngesilinganiso senani lokuthenga, uma iqhathaniswa no-12.8% kubo bonke abathengi bezindlu onyakeni kuze kube ngu-October. Izinga lokuvunywa kwalemalimboleko belingu-83.9% ngesilinganiso kulo nyaka, kanti i-ooba ithole izinga eliyi-prime elingu-minus 0.77% ngo-October, le mininingwane ikhomba njalo.

Izicelo ezihlanganisa izindleko zomthetho, zentela kanye nezokuphatha zenze u-10.1% wezicelo ngoSeptember no-October. IBabhanki Enkulu (SARB) lishiye izinga lenzalo yezikweletu (repo rate) lingashintshile emhlanganweni walo kaNovemba, kanti izinga lenzalo yebhange (prime lending rate) lisezinsukwini ezingu-10.75%.

7957da94dfd17fc4a33c.headline: AmaBhokobhoko afinyelela kowamanqamu naphezu kokuhlulwa yi-Ireland
7957da94dfd17fc4a33c.dek: I-Ireland inqobile eDublin, kodwa iphoyinti leBokobhoko lokulahlekelwa liyazifikisa kowamanqamu eTwickenham.
7957da94dfd17fc4a33c.why: AmaBhokobhoko afanele alungiselele owamanqamu eTwickenham ngeSonto elizayo, ebhekene neFrance noma i-England.
paragraphs: I-Ireland inqobe iNingizimu Afrika ngo-20-17 eDublin ngoMgqibelo, kodwa amaBhokobhoko athole iphoyinti lokulahlekelwa ngokwehlulwa ngamaphoyinti angaphansi kwayisikhombisa futhi aqhubekela phambili kowamanqamu eNations Championship. Lo mdlalo ubuse-Aviva Stadium, kanti ukunqotshwa bekungokwesibili kulandelana kwamaBhokobhoko ngemuva kokuhlulwa yiFrance ngempelasonto edlule.

I-Ireland ihambe phambili ngo-17-10 ngesikhathi sekhefu futhi ishaye imizamo emithathu kune yaseNingizimu Afrika emibili. I-Ireland inqobe ibhola lama-lineout, yaphatha umdlalo futhi yagcina amaBhokobhoko ecindezelwe ohlangothini lwawo isikhathi esiningi somdlalo. U-Rassie Erasmus, umqeqeshi omisiwe, ubukele eshotela leqembu.

Owamanqamu useTwickenham ngeSonto elizayo, lapho iNingizimu Afrika kulindeleke ukuthi ibhekane neFrance noma i-England. IFrance ibihlelelwe ukudlala ne-Argentina ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngoMgqibelo, kanti ukunqoba kwe-England kuma-All Blacks ngalolo suku kusho ukuthi bayazibandakanya uma iNingizimu Afrika ingaphumeleli.

7bf61dcd827ff3960355.headline: INingizimu Afrika imisa ikomidi njengoba isifo sem Macadamia sithinta amahektha angu-34,000
7bf61dcd827ff3960355.dek: Lesi sifo sithinta cishe ingxenye yendawo etshalwe ngama-macadamia ezweni, kanti ukwanda kwaso kwehlisa isivuno futhi kubeka imisebenzi engcupheni.
7bf61dcd827ff3960355.why: Abalimi bama-macadamia babhekene nezindleko zemithi zika-R100,000 ngehektha ezindaweni ezithintekile, kanti ikomidi eliholwauhulumeni lizohlanganyela ukweseka nokuvuselela.
paragraphs: UMnyango Wezolimo eNingizimu Afrika uthi isifo sama-macadamia felted coccid sesisakazeke cishe kumahektha angu-34,000 ama-orchards, cishe ingxenye yendawo etshalwe kuleli. Kuqinisekisiwe e-Ohrigstad, eLimpopo, ngoNovemba, ngemuva kokusakazeka eMpumalanga Koloni kusukela kuqale ukubonakala eBarberton Valley ngo-2017.

Ukuhlolwa kwamapulazi kuthole ukulimala amaqabunga, izihlahla ezifayo namantongomane amancane; ezinye izihlahla bezinomonakalo ongaphezulu kuka-80% ophahleni lwesihlahla. Esimweni sokusakazeka kakhulu, cishe amahektha angu-14,600 eMpumalanga abhekene nokulahlekelwa isivuno esingafika ku-70%, kanti imisebenzi engu-5,950 isengcupheni. I-Macadamias South Africa ithi isichithe ngaphezu kuka-R6.3 wezigidi ocwaningweni kuze kube ngu-2026. Abalimi babika ukuthi izindleko zemithi zenyuka zisuka ku-R60,000-R70,000 ngehektha ngaphandle kwalesi sifo ziya ku-R100,000 uma ukulawula kungezwa.

Ngemuva kokuvakashela amapulazi ngoNovemba, uhulumeni ubize abathintekayo ukuba baxoxisane ngohlelo lokuqina. Ikomidi eliholwa uhulumeni kazwelonke nelwesifundazwe liphakanyisiwe ukuxhumanisa ucwaningo, ukubhaliswa, ukwesekwa kwabalimi kanye nokuvuselelwa kwama-orchards.

d02dd96ed7fa34382d85.headline: I-ANC ifuna izivumelwano zokubambisana emadolobheni ngo-27 November
d02dd96ed7fa34382d85.dek: Leli qembu lithole u-31% wamavoti kodwa lathola amavoti amaningi emadolobheni amabili kuphela kweziyisishiyagalolunye zaseNingizimu Afrika.
d02dd96ed7fa34382d85.why: Amaqembu axoxisana ngohulumeni basekhaya baseNingizimu Afrika kufanele afinyelele ezivumelwaneni mhla ziyi-27 kuNovemba, ngemuva kokuthi i-ANC ilahlekelwe ukulawula emkhandlwini engaphezu kwesigamu saleyo yase-2021.
paragraphs: Amaqembu aseNingizimu Afrika anesikhathi kuze kube mhla ziyi-27 kuNovemba ukuthi axoxisane futhi akhe ohulumeni basekhaya, kanti i-African National Congress (ANC) ifuna izivumelwano zokubambisana ukusebenza amadolobha ngemuva kokulahlekelwa kulolu khetho lwasekhaya lwale nyanga.

Isabelo sayo samavoti sehle saba u-31%, sisuka ku-46% okhethweni lwasendaweni olwedlule, futhi ithole amavoti amaningi emadolobheni amabili kuphela kweziyisishiyagalolunye zezwe, uma kuqhathaniswa nesithupha ngo-2021. I-ANC ithole iningi eLimpopo kuphela, isifundazwe saseNingizimu Afrika esisodwa kwesiyisishiyagalolunye, sehle sisuka ezifundazweni eziyisithupha ngaphambili.

EGauteng, ikhaya laseGoli nasePitoli, iDemocratic Alliance eqondene namabhizinisi ithole amavoti amaningi kuwo womabili amadolobha nase-Ekurhuleni, esinye isifunda esikhulu sesifundazwe. I-ANC isaqhubekile nokuthola amavoti amaningi uwonke kunaliphi elinye qembu, kodwa ilahlekelwe ukulawula imikhandlu engaphezu kwesigamu ebibambe ngayo ngo-2021.
